unit.title: Reading CVC Words and Simple Sentences

contentBlocks.text: This week you've read CVC words with short A, short I, and even a digraph. Today we'll put words together into something bigger: a full sentence.

Read this sentence word by word, blending each one: 'The cat sat.' Now read it again, a little faster, like a real sentence. Notice: a sentence starts with a capital letter and ends with a period. Try one more: 'The fish can sit.' Read it slowly first, then try it smoothly, like you're really telling someone about the fish.
You just read two whole sentences! Every sentence you'll ever read is built the same way — words you can blend, put together one after another.

objectives: Read a simple decodable sentence word by word, then with increasing fluency
Recognize that a sentence starts with a capital letter and ends with a period
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Write or point to 'The cat sat.' and read it together word by word.
2. Read it again a bit faster, encouraging natural sentence rhythm rather than robotic word-by-word reading.
3. Point out the capital letter at the start and the period at the end.
4. Repeat with 'The fish can sit.'
5. Move to the worksheet: read and copy each sentence.
6. Close by having the child read both sentences aloud one more time, as smoothly as they can.
differentiationTips: Struggling: it's fine to keep reading word by word rather than pushing for fluent phrasing yet — accuracy comes first
Ready for more: ask the child to make up their own short sentence using this week's words (cat, sat, sit, fish, ship)
For a child who enjoys performing, have them 'read aloud' the sentence to a stuffed animal or family member
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is a reading and copying-practice activity — check that the child can read both sentences accurately, at whatever pace feels comfortable.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Reading a full decodable sentence, built entirely from this week's known sounds and words, is the payoff moment that shows phonics skills translate into real reading — a core Grade 1 milestone.

generationData.instructions: Read each sentence aloud, then copy it on the line below.
